concerns.text: The plan’s step list (download → preprocess → connectivity → centrality → PLI → VIF → sample‑size check → correlation → Bonferroni → report) never mentions the creation of the intermediate `SubjectMetrics.csv` file defined in the data model. This omission leaves the `SubjectMetrics` entity without a corresponding production step, breaking Plan ↔ Data‑Model consistency.

While the FR/SC matrix lists functional requirements, it does not reference any step that validates `data/metrics/SubjectMetrics.csv` against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. Consequently, the `dataset.schema.yaml` contract is not exercised by any plan element, violating the Plan ↔ Contracts linkage.
